pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal patches with soft, feathered edge gradients; coloration transitions from light tan at boundaries to darker brown centers. Patches on the lower neck are smaller and more compressed than those on the flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored interstitial pathways; junction nodes primarily exhibit tri-radial connectivity; pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the visible lateral surface.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the dorsal neck mane, characterized by a fine-textured fringe against the background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A localized dark, recessed area of textural disruption is visible on the upper dorsal ridge, appearing as a distinct indentation or break in the pelage surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, dark, elongated lesion or cleft is visible on the upper shoulder/dorsal region, exhibiting high contrast against the surrounding light-colored interstitial tissue.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian subject perched directly on the dorsal ridge near the identified anatomical anomaly.
